# agentic-repurpose

Turn one source into platform-ready post variants.

Keywords: repurpose,content,social,agentic-suite,cli,mcp.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-repurpose".
- CLI: agentic-repurpose summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-repurpose mcp, then call summarize_text.

## Docs
